name: Android Settings Skills
description: Optimal instructions for navigating Android system settings.
instructions:
When interacting with Android Settings, do NOT scroll manually to find a setting. This takes too long and fails frequently.
1. Find the search bar or search icon at the top/bottom of the main Settings page.
2. Tap it and type the exact setting you are looking for (e.g. 'Wi-Fi', 'Bluetooth', 'Display').
3. Wait for the search results to load and tap the corresponding result.
4. If a setting requires a toggle, look for a switch element and tap it to enable/disable. 
5. If you can't find settings by searching, cancel the search and start searching manually by swiping..
